what_this_is: The deterministic gate. No model calls, no secrets, runs in seconds on everything. It decides only what is decidable without judgement. Run it before any model call: spending a draft-gate token on an em dash is waste.

canon_exemption.why: A canon document names retired brands in order to forbid them. A gate that blocks its own rulebook does not survive contact with a deadline.

paid_tier_exemption.why: The media kit makes CTRL beta access in the paid tier the one permitted connection between the channel and mind/make. Paid-tier copy names it; every other rule still runs, Mindmake included.

legal_entity_exemption.why: Mindmaker LLC (United States) and Mindmaker Ltd (United Kingdom) are the companies that operate the site, not the retired publication name. A file in this scope may write those two exact strings and nothing more: bare Mindmaker and Mindmaker Live stay vetoed, and every other rule still runs. Krish, 2026-10-19. On the cover the only such file is apps/cover/content/legal-entities.md, read by the footer note and the terms and privacy pages.

words: at the end of the day

vetoes.says: A closing moral or a lesson for leaders. Unappealable.

warnings.says: A figure with no named producer nearby. A regex cannot decide attribution, so this flags a candidate and the Fact Checker holds the veto.
Arithmetic with no preceding paragraph on the quality of the evidence. Flagged, not blocked, for the same reason.

why_two_are_warnings: A crude heuristic with an absolute veto produces false blocks and gets the gate switched off in week two. The Fact Checker holds both vetoes.
